# Setup

```{r}
# Load libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(patchwork)
library(ggridges)
library(ggalluvial)
library(forcats)
library(HDAnalyzeR)
library(ggConvexHull)
library(UpSetR)
library(ggvenn)
library(eulerr)
library(pROC)
library(ggrepel)
library(ggpubr)

# Specify function
select <- dplyr::select
filter <- dplyr::filter
mutate <- dplyr::mutate
rename <- dplyr::rename

# Set ggplot2 defaults
ggplot2::update_geom_defaults(
  "point",
  list(size = 2, alpha = 0.6)
)

# Source scripts
source("../scripts/functions/themes_palettes.R")
source("../scripts/functions/functions_disease_analyses.R")

# Read data
metadata <- read_csv("../data/curated/metadata.csv")
data_long <- read_csv("../data/curated/data_long.csv")
data_wide <- read_csv("../data/curated/data_wide.csv")
data_long_ml <- read_csv("../data/curated/data_long_ml.csv")
data_wide_ml <- read_csv("../data/curated/data_wide_ml.csv")
```

# Figure 3

## Figure 3A

```{r}
# 1. Define CD4/CD8 category levels (legend order)
cd4cd8_levels <- c("Normal", "Low", "Very low")

# 2. Define subgroup order
subgroup_levels <- c(
  "Elite controller",
  "More preserved immunity",
  "Severely impaired immunity",
  "Primary HIV infection"
)

cd4cd8_followup <- metadata %>%
  filter(Disease == "HIV") %>%
  distinct(ID, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  filter(!is.na(`CD4/CD8 status (follow-up)`)) %>%
  mutate(
    status   = factor(`CD4/CD8 status (follow-up)`, levels = cd4cd8_levels),
    Subgroup = factor(Subgroup, levels = subgroup_levels)
  ) %>%
  count(Subgroup, status)

subgroup_labels_fu <- cd4cd8_followup |>
  mutate(Subgroup = factor(Subgroup, levels = subgroup_levels))

p_cd4cd8_followup <- ggplot(cd4cd8_followup,
                            aes(x = Subgroup, y = n, fill = status)) +
  geom_col(color = "white", width = 0.7) +
  
  # Larger numbers inside bars
  geom_text(
    aes(label = n),
    position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5),
    color = "black",
    size = 7
  ) +
  
  scale_fill_manual(
    name = "CD4/CD8 T-cell count status",
    values = c(
      "Very low" = "#d95f02",
      "Low"      = "grey80",
      "Normal"   = "#1b9e77"
    )
  ) +
  
  scale_x_discrete(labels = subgroup_labels_fu) +
  
  # Ensure axis numbers appear
  scale_y_continuous(
    expand = expansion(add = c(0, 0)),
    name = "Number of individuals",
    breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(n = 5)
  ) +
  
  labs(
  title = "Follow-up CD4/CD8 T-cell count status by HIV-1 subgroup",
  x = "HIV-1 subgroup",
  y = "Number of individuals",
  fill = "CD4/CD8 Status"
) +
  
  coord_flip() +
  theme_hiv()

p_cd4cd8_followup
```

## Figure 3B

```{r}
input_df <- data_wide_ml |> filter(DAid %in% (metadata |> filter(Disease %in% c("HIV", "Healthy")))$DAid)

pca_df <- hd_pca(
  dat = input_df,
  components = 10,
  by_sample = TRUE,
  impute = TRUE,
  seed = 123
)

timepoint_colors <- c(
  "Baseline"  = "#E94849",
  "Follow-up" = "#5F98C6",
  "Healthy"   = "#71BF6E"
)

hiv_panels <- c(
  "Primary HIV infection",
  "More preserved immunity",
  "Severely impaired immunity",
  "Elite controller"
)

plot_df <- pca_df$pca_res |>
  inner_join(metadata, by = "DAid") |>
  # Make ID into character
  mutate(ID = as.character(ID)) |>
  dplyr::filter(Subgroup %in% c(hiv_panels, "Healthy")) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    Facet_group = Subgroup,
    # ensure Healthy has a consistent Timepoint label
    Timepoint = ifelse(Subgroup == "Healthy", "Healthy", Timepoint)
  )

healthy_df <- plot_df |>
  dplyr::filter(Subgroup == "Healthy") |>
  dplyr::select(-Facet_group) |>
  tidyr::expand_grid(Facet_group = hiv_panels)

plot_df <- plot_df |>
  dplyr::filter(Subgroup != "Healthy") |>
  dplyr::bind_rows(healthy_df)

plot_df$Facet_group <- factor(plot_df$Facet_group, levels = hiv_panels)


pc1 <- pca_df$pca_variance$percent_variance[1]
pc2 <- pca_df$pca_variance$percent_variance[2]

p_pca_split_timepoint <- ggplot(
  plot_df,
  aes(x = PC1, y = PC2)
) +

  # 🔹 Filled ellipses (behind everything)
  stat_ellipse(
    data = plot_df,
    aes(
      fill  = Timepoint,
      group = interaction(Timepoint, Facet_group)
    ),
    geom  = "polygon",
    alpha = 0.15,
    colour = NA
  ) +

  # 🔹 Dashed ellipse outlines
  stat_ellipse(
    data = plot_df,
    aes(
      colour = Timepoint,
      group  = interaction(Timepoint, Facet_group)
    ),
    linetype = "dashed",
    linewidth = 0.6
  ) +

  # 🔹 Thin grey paired lines (HIV only)
  geom_line(
    data = plot_df |>
      dplyr::filter(
        Disease == "HIV",
        Timepoint %in% c("Baseline", "Follow-up")
      ),
    aes(group = interaction(ID, Facet_group)),
    colour = "grey70",
    linewidth = 0.3,
    alpha = 0.6
  ) +

  # 🔹 Points (on top)
  geom_point(
    aes(color = Timepoint),
    size   = 3,
    alpha  = 0.7,
    stroke = 0
  ) +

  facet_wrap(~ Facet_group, ncol = 2) +
  scale_color_manual(values = timepoint_colors) +
  scale_fill_manual(values  = timepoint_colors) +
  labs(
    title = "PCA of HIV-1 subgroups (at baseline and follow-up) and Healthy",
    x = paste0("PC1 (", round(pc1, 2), "%)"),
    y = paste0("PC2 (", round(pc2, 2), "%)"),
    color = "Timepoint",
    fill  = "Timepoint"
  ) +
  theme_hiv() +
  coord_equal()

p_pca_split_timepoint
```

```{r}
# Save PCA variance and loadings for Figure 3B
fig3b_pca <- pca_df$pca_variance |> mutate(Figure = "Figure 3B") |> mutate(Comparison = "HIV (baseline), HIV (follow-up), Healthy")
fig3b_pca |> write_xlsx("../tables/PCA/fig3b_pca_variance.xlsx")

fig3b_pca_contribution <- pca_df$pca_loadings |> mutate(Figure = "Figure 3B") |> mutate(Comparison = "HIV (baseline), HIV (follow-up), Healthy") |>
  # select the top 15 terms from PC1 and PC2
  group_by(component) |> slice_max(order_by = abs(value), n = 15) |> ungroup() |> filter(component %in% c("PC1", "PC2"))
fig3b_pca_contribution |> write_xlsx("../tables/PCA/fig3b_pca_loadings.xlsx")
```

## Figure 3C

```{r}
input_metadata <- metadata |>
  filter(Disease == "HIV") |>
  filter(!Subgroup %in% c("Healthy", "Elite controller")) |>
  mutate(Age = ifelse(is.na(Age), `Age (baseline)`, Age)) |>
  mutate(BMI = ifelse(is.na(BMI), `BMI (baseline)`, BMI)) |>
  mutate(ID = as.character(ID)) |>
  # Mutate Follow-up to FU in Timepoint
  mutate(Timepoint = ifelse(Timepoint == "Follow-up", "FU", Timepoint))

input_data <- data_wide |>
  filter(DAid %in% input_metadata$DAid)

hd_obj <- HDAnalyzeR::hd_initialize(dat = input_data, 
                        metadata = input_metadata, 
                        is_wide = TRUE, 
                        sample_id = "DAid",
                        var_name = "Feature",
                        value_name = "NPX")

de_results <- hd_de_limma_paired(hd_obj, 
                          variable = "Timepoint", 
                          case = "FU", 
                          control = "Baseline", 
                          correct = NULL,
                          paired = TRUE,
                          id_column = "ID") |> 
  hd_plot_volcano(pval_lim = 0.05,
                  logfc_lim = 0.5,
                  top_up_prot = 5,
                  top_down_prot = 10,
                  title = "PLWH follow-up vs baseline (excluding ECs)",
                  report_nproteins = FALSE,
                  user_defined_proteins = NULL)

head(de_results$de_res)

res_hiv_fu_baseline <- de_results$de_res

p <- de_results$volcano_plot +
  theme_hiv() +
  theme(legend.position = "right") +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "significant down" = "#317EC2",
      "significant up"   = "#C03830",
      "not significant"  = "#C4C4C4"
    ),
    labels = c(
      "significant down" = "Significantly decreased",
      "significant up"   = "Significantly increased",
      "not significant"  = "Not significant"
    ),
    name = NULL   # removes legend title ("Significance")
  ) +
  labs(
    y = expression(-log[10]("adjusted p-value")),
    x = expression(log[2]("fold change"))
  )

p$layers[[1]]$aes_params$size   <- 3
p$layers[[1]]$aes_params$alpha  <- 0.7
p$layers[[1]]$aes_params$stroke <- 0

p

p_volcano_hiv_fu_baseline <- p
```

## Figure 3D

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggbeeswarm)

highlighted_proteins <- c(
  "PDCD1","CD6","CD8A","CXCL10","CXCL13",
  "CD48","CXCL9","LAG3","TNFSRSF8"
)

# --------------------------------------------------
# Subgroup order
# --------------------------------------------------

desired_order <- c(
  "Primary HIV infection",
  "More preserved immunity",
  "Severely impaired immunity",
  "Elite controller",
  "Healthy"
)

# --------------------------------------------------
# Abbreviations
# --------------------------------------------------

subgroup_abbrev <- c(
  "Primary HIV infection"     = "PHI",
  "More preserved immunity"   = "MPI",
  "Severely impaired immunity"= "SII",
  "Elite controller"          = "EC",
  "Healthy"                   = "Healthy"
)

# --------------------------------------------------
# Legend labels
# --------------------------------------------------

legend_labels <- c(
  "Primary HIV infection"      = "Primary HIV-1 infection (PHI)",
  "More preserved immunity"    = "More preserved immunity (MPI)",
  "Severely impaired immunity" = "Severely impaired immunity (SII)",
  "Elite controller"           = "Elite controller (EC)",
  "Healthy"                    = "Healthy"
)

# --------------------------------------------------
# Prepare data
# --------------------------------------------------

p_up <- data_long %>%
  select(DAid, Feature, NPX) %>%
  right_join(metadata, by = "DAid") %>%
  filter(
    Feature %in% highlighted_proteins,
    Subgroup %in% desired_order
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Feature = factor(Feature, levels = highlighted_proteins),
    Subgroup = factor(Subgroup, levels = desired_order),

    Subgroup_time = case_when(
      Subgroup == "Healthy" ~ "Healthy",
      TRUE ~ paste0(
        subgroup_abbrev[Subgroup],
        " (",
        tolower(Timepoint),
        ")"
      )
    )
  )

# --------------------------------------------------
# X-axis order
# --------------------------------------------------

x_order <- c(
  "PHI (baseline)",
  "PHI (follow-up)",
  "MPI (baseline)",
  "MPI (follow-up)",
  "SII (baseline)",
  "SII (follow-up)",
  "EC (baseline)",
  "EC (follow-up)",
  "Healthy"
)

p_up$Subgroup_time <- factor(p_up$Subgroup_time, levels = x_order)

# --------------------------------------------------
# Plot
# --------------------------------------------------

p_boxplot_immune_reconstitution <- ggplot(
  p_up,
  aes(
    x     = Subgroup_time,
    y     = NPX,
    color = Subgroup,
    fill  = Subgroup
  )
) +
  geom_quasirandom(
    alpha  = 0.7,
    stroke = 0,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_boxplot(
    color = "black",
    outlier.shape = NA,
    alpha = 0.6
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~Feature, ncol = 4, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = Subgroup_colors,
    labels = legend_labels
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = Subgroup_colors,
    labels = legend_labels
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme_hiv() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 75, hjust = 1),
    legend.position = "right"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Immune reconstitution of proteins across HIV-1 subgroups at baseline and follow-up",
    x     = "HIV-1 subgroup (Timepoint) / Cohort",
    y     = "NPX",
    color = "HIV-1 subgroup",
    fill  = "HIV-1 subgroup"
  )

p_boxplot_immune_reconstitution
```

## Figure 3H

```{r}
fdr_cutoff   <- 0.05
logfc_cutoff <- 0.50

venn_sets <- list(
  "PHI" =
    phi_paired$de_results |>
      filter(adj.P.Val < fdr_cutoff, abs(logFC) > logfc_cutoff) |>
      pull(Feature),

  "MPI" =
    mpi_paired$de_results |>
      filter(adj.P.Val < fdr_cutoff, abs(logFC) > logfc_cutoff) |>
      pull(Feature),

  "SII" =
    sii_paired$de_results |>
      filter(adj.P.Val < fdr_cutoff, abs(logFC) > logfc_cutoff) |>
      pull(Feature)
)

venn_colors <- c("#4B988F", "#C89A1B", "#EABBBB")

plot_overlap_fu_baseline <- ggvenn(
  venn_sets,
  show_elements = FALSE,      # 🔑 prints protein names
  set_name_size = 5,
  text_size     = 5,
  fill_color   = venn_colors
)

plot_overlap_fu_baseline
```

### Alternative

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(eulerr)

# --------------------------------------------------
# 1. Thresholds
# --------------------------------------------------

fdr_cutoff   <- 0.05
logfc_cutoff <- 0.50

# --------------------------------------------------
# 2. Extract significant proteins
# --------------------------------------------------

venn_sets <- list(
  PHI =
    phi_paired$de_results |>
      filter(adj.P.Val < fdr_cutoff, abs(logFC) > logfc_cutoff) |>
      pull(Feature),

  MPI =
    mpi_paired$de_results |>
      filter(adj.P.Val < fdr_cutoff, abs(logFC) > logfc_cutoff) |>
      pull(Feature),

  SII =
    sii_paired$de_results |>
      filter(adj.P.Val < fdr_cutoff, abs(logFC) > logfc_cutoff) |>
      pull(Feature)
)

# --------------------------------------------------
# 3. Create Euler object
# --------------------------------------------------

fit <- euler(venn_sets)

# --------------------------------------------------
# 4. Colors
# --------------------------------------------------

venn_colors <- c(
  PHI = "#4B988F",
  MPI = "#C89A1B",
  SII = "#EABBBB"
)

# --------------------------------------------------
# 5. Plot
# --------------------------------------------------

plot_overlap_fu_baseline <- plot(
  fit,
  fills = list(fill = venn_colors, alpha = 0.6),
  edges = list(col = "black"),
  quantities = list(
    type = "counts",
    cex = 2.2
  ),
  labels = list(
    cex = 2.2
  )
)

plot_overlap_fu_baseline
```

## Figure 3I

```{r}
# --------------------------------------------------
# 1. Combine all result tables
# --------------------------------------------------

all_res <- list(
  PHI = phi_vs_healthy_fu$de_results,
  SII = sii_vs_healthy_fu$de_results,
  MPI = mpi_vs_healthy_fu$de_results,
  EC  = ec_vs_healthy_fu$de_results
) |>
  imap_dfr(~ .x |> mutate(Comparison = .y))

# --------------------------------------------------
# 2. Classify significance
# --------------------------------------------------

plot_df <- all_res |>
  mutate(
    Comparison = factor(Comparison, levels = c("PHI", "SII", "MPI", "EC")),
    Significance = case_when(
      adj.P.Val < 0.05 & logFC > 0.5  ~ "Significant increased",
      adj.P.Val < 0.05 & logFC < -0.5 ~ "Significant decreased",
      TRUE                            ~ "Not significant"
    )
  ) |>
  group_by(Comparison, Significance) |>
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop")

# --------------------------------------------------
# 3. Plot stacked barplot
# --------------------------------------------------

p_bar_subgroup_fu_healthy <- plot_df |>
  ggplot(aes(x = Comparison, y = n, fill = Significance)) +
  geom_col(position = "stack") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "Significant increased" = "#C03830",
    "Significant decreased" = "#317EC2",
    "Not significant" = "grey80"
  )) +
  labs(
    title = "Significant proteins & logFC > 0.5 across HIV-1 subgroups",
    x = "Comparison",
    y = "Number of proteins",
    fill = "Significance"
  ) +
  theme_hiv()

p_bar_subgroup_fu_healthy
```

## Figure 3J

```{r}
fdr_cutoff <- 0.5

set_colors <- c(
  "#5A588B",  # EC
  "#C89A1B",  # MPI
  "#EABBBB",  # SII
  "#4B988F"   # PHI
)

# --------------------------------------------------
# 1. Define result list (reversed order)
# --------------------------------------------------

res_list_healthy <- list(
  `EC vs. Healthy`  = ec_vs_healthy_fu$de_results,
  `MPI vs. Healthy` = mpi_vs_healthy_fu$de_results,
  `SII vs. Healthy` = sii_vs_healthy_fu$de_results,
  `PHI vs. Healthy` = phi_vs_healthy_fu$de_results
)

# --------------------------------------------------
# 2. Extract significantly increased proteins
# --------------------------------------------------

up_sets <- lapply(res_list_healthy, function(df) {
  df |>
    filter(
      adj.P.Val < fdr_cutoff,
      logFC > 0.5
    ) |>
    pull(Feature)
})

# --------------------------------------------------
# 3. Sanity check
# --------------------------------------------------

message("Proteins per set:")
print(sapply(up_sets, length))

# --------------------------------------------------
# 4. Convert list to UpSet matrix
# --------------------------------------------------

up_mat <- UpSetR::fromList(up_sets)

# --------------------------------------------------
# 5. Save UpSet plot
# --------------------------------------------------

pdf(
  "../plots/pdf/overlap/upset_increased_proteins_sii_mpi_phi_ec_healthy_fu.pdf",
  width = 14,
  height = 6,
  onefile = FALSE
)

print(
  upset(
  up_mat,
  sets = names(up_sets),
  order.by = "freq",
  empty.intersections = "off",
  keep.order = TRUE,
  sets.bar.color = set_colors,
  mainbar.y.label = "Number of proteins",
  sets.x.label = "Proteins per comparison",
  text.scale = c(2, 2, 2, 2, 2, 3)
)
)

dev.off()
```

## Figure 3K

```{r}
fdr_cutoff <- 0.5

set_colors <- c(
  "#5A588B",  # EC
  "#C89A1B",  # MPI
  "#EABBBB",  # SII
  "#4B988F"   # PHI
)

# --------------------------------------------------
# 1. Define result list (reversed order)
# --------------------------------------------------

res_list_healthy <- list(
  `EC vs. Healthy`  = ec_vs_healthy_fu$de_results,
  `MPI vs. Healthy` = mpi_vs_healthy_fu$de_results,
  `SII vs. Healthy` = sii_vs_healthy_fu$de_results,
  `PHI vs. Healthy` = phi_vs_healthy_fu$de_results
)

# --------------------------------------------------
# 2. Extract significantly decreased proteins
# --------------------------------------------------

down_sets <- lapply(res_list_healthy, function(df) {
  df |>
    filter(
      adj.P.Val < fdr_cutoff,
      logFC < -0.5
    ) |>
    pull(Feature)
})

# --------------------------------------------------
# 3. Sanity check
# --------------------------------------------------

message("Proteins per set:")
print(sapply(down_sets, length))

# --------------------------------------------------
# 4. Convert list to UpSet matrix
# --------------------------------------------------

down_mat <- UpSetR::fromList(down_sets)

# --------------------------------------------------
# 5. Save UpSet plot
# --------------------------------------------------

pdf(
  "../plots/pdf/overlap/upset_decreased_proteins_sii_mpi_phi_ec_healthy_fu.pdf",
  width = 14,
  height = 6,
  onefile = FALSE
)

print(
  upset(
    down_mat,
    sets = names(down_sets),
    order.by = "freq",
    empty.intersections = "off",
    keep.order = TRUE,
    nintersects = NA,
    sets.bar.color = set_colors,
    mainbar.y.label = "Number of proteins",
    sets.x.label = "Proteins per comparison",
    text.scale = c(2, 2, 2, 2, 2, 3)
  )
)

dev.off()
```

# Supplementary Figure 9

## S9A

```{r}
# --------------------------------------------------
# Prepare metadata
# --------------------------------------------------

input_metadata <- metadata |>
  filter(Timepoint == "Follow-up") |>
  filter(Disease == "HIV") |>
  mutate(Subgroup = factor(Subgroup))

input_data <- data_wide_ml |>
  filter(DAid %in% input_metadata$DAid)

hd_obj <- HDAnalyzeR::hd_initialize(
  dat = input_data,
  metadata = input_metadata,
  is_wide = TRUE,
  sample_id = "DAid",
  var_name = "Feature",
  value_name = "NPX"
)

# --------------------------------------------------
# Function to check valid split
# --------------------------------------------------

valid_split <- function(split_obj, min_samples = 3) {

  train_counts <- table(split_obj$train_data$Subgroup)
  test_counts  <- table(split_obj$test_data$Subgroup)

  all_levels <- levels(input_metadata$Subgroup)

  # must contain all classes
  if(!all(all_levels %in% names(train_counts))) return(FALSE)
  if(!all(all_levels %in% names(test_counts)))  return(FALSE)

  # must have enough samples
  if(any(train_counts < min_samples)) return(FALSE)
  if(any(test_counts < min_samples))  return(FALSE)

  TRUE
}

# --------------------------------------------------
# Run multiple safe splits
# --------------------------------------------------

n_splits <- 100

model_results <- list()
split_objects <- list()

i <- 1
seed <- 1

while(i <= n_splits){

  message("Trying split with seed ", seed)

  split_candidate <- hd_split_data(
    hd_obj,
    variable = "Subgroup",
    ratio = 0.7,
    seed = seed
  )

  if(valid_split(split_candidate)){

    message("✓ Valid split found")

    model_fit <- tryCatch({

      hd_model_rreg(
        dat = split_candidate,
        variable = "Subgroup",
        case = NULL,
        balance_groups = FALSE,
        cor_threshold = 1,
        grid_size = 30,
        cv_sets = 5,
        mixture = 1,
        palette = NULL,
        plot_y_labels = TRUE,
        verbose = FALSE,
        seed = seed
      )

    }, error = function(e){

      message("✗ Model failed: skipping split")
      NULL

    })

    if(!is.null(model_fit)){

      model_results[[i]] <- model_fit
      split_objects[[i]] <- split_candidate

      i <- i + 1
    }
  }

  seed <- seed + 1
}

names(model_results) <- paste0("split_", seq_len(n_splits))
```


```{r}
# --------------------------------------------------
# 1. Extract feature importance from all splits
# --------------------------------------------------

feature_importance_df <- purrr::imap_dfr(
  model_results,
  function(model, split_name) {

    model$features |>
      mutate(Split = split_name)

  }
)

# --------------------------------------------------
# 2. Remove zero importance features
# --------------------------------------------------

feature_importance_df <- feature_importance_df |>
  filter(Scaled_Importance > 0)

# --------------------------------------------------
# 3. Compute how many splits each protein appears in
# --------------------------------------------------

feature_importance_df <- feature_importance_df |>
  group_by(Class, Feature) |>
  mutate(
    n_selected = n_distinct(Split)
  ) |>
  ungroup()

# --------------------------------------------------
# 4. Keep proteins selected >5 times
# --------------------------------------------------

feature_importance_df <- feature_importance_df |>
  filter(n_selected > 5)

# --------------------------------------------------
# 5. Identify top proteins per class
# --------------------------------------------------

top_features <- feature_importance_df |>
  group_by(Class, Feature) |>
  summarise(
    mean_importance = mean(Scaled_Importance),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  group_by(Class) |>
  slice_max(mean_importance, n = 15)

plot_df <- feature_importance_df |>
  semi_join(top_features, by = c("Class", "Feature"))

# --------------------------------------------------
# 6. Create labels with selection frequency
# --------------------------------------------------

plot_df <- plot_df |>
  mutate(
    Feature_label = paste0(Feature, " (n=", n_selected, ")")
  )

# --------------------------------------------------
# 7. Order features by median importance
# --------------------------------------------------

feature_order <- plot_df |>
  group_by(Feature_label) |>
  summarise(
    median_importance = median(Scaled_Importance),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(median_importance) |>
  pull(Feature_label)

plot_df_ml_fu <- plot_df |>
  mutate(
    Feature_label = factor(Feature_label, levels = feature_order)
  )

# --------------------------------------------------
# 8. Plot
# --------------------------------------------------

p_feature_stability <- ggplot(
  plot_df_ml_fu,
  aes(
    x = Feature_label,
    y = Scaled_Importance,
    fill = Class
  )
) +
  geom_boxplot(
    alpha = 0.85,
    outlier.shape = NA
  ) +
  geom_jitter(
    width = 0.15,
    size = 1,
    alpha = 0.6
  ) +
  coord_flip() +
  facet_wrap(~Class, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = Subgroup_colors) +
  theme_hiv() +
  labs(
    title = "Protein importance stability across model splits",
    x = "Protein",
    y = "Scaled feature importance",
    fill = "HIV subgroup"
  )

p_feature_stability

# --------------------------------------------------
# 9. Save figure
# --------------------------------------------------

ggsave(
  filename = "Feature_importance_stability_across_splits_scaled_fu.pdf",
  path     = "../plots/pdf/model/",
  plot     = p_feature_stability,
  width    = 16,
  height   = 10
)

ggsave(
  filename = "Feature_importance_stability_across_splits_scaled_fu.png",
  path     = "../plots/png/model/",
  plot     = p_feature_stability,
  width    = 16,
  height   = 10
)

multivariate_lasso_fu <- plot_df_ml_fu
```

## S9B

```{r}
# --------------------------------------------------
# 1. Extract ROC curves from all splits
# --------------------------------------------------

roc_all <- purrr::imap_dfr(
  model_results,
  function(model, split_name) {
    
    model$roc_curve$data |>
      mutate(Split = split_name)
    
  }
)

# --------------------------------------------------
# 2. Clean ROC curves
# --------------------------------------------------

roc_clean <- roc_all |>
  select(.level, Split, specificity, sensitivity) |>
  filter(!is.na(specificity), !is.na(sensitivity)) |>
  group_by(.level, Split, specificity) |>
  summarise(
    sensitivity = mean(sensitivity),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(.level, Split, specificity)

# --------------------------------------------------
# 3. Interpolation grid
# --------------------------------------------------

spec_grid <- seq(0, 1, length.out = 200)

# --------------------------------------------------
# 4. Interpolate ROC curves
# --------------------------------------------------

roc_interp <- roc_clean |>
  group_by(.level, Split) |>
  group_modify(~{

    df <- arrange(.x, specificity)

    approx_res <- approx(
      x = df$specificity,
      y = df$sensitivity,
      xout = spec_grid,
      rule = 2
    )

    tibble(
      specificity = approx_res$x,
      sensitivity = approx_res$y
    )

  }) |>
  ungroup()

# --------------------------------------------------
# 5. Mean ROC curve
# --------------------------------------------------

roc_mean <- roc_interp |>
  group_by(.level, specificity) |>
  summarise(
    mean_sensitivity = mean(sensitivity),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# --------------------------------------------------
# 6. Compute AUC per split
# --------------------------------------------------

auc_df <- roc_interp |>
  group_by(.level, Split) |>
  summarise(
    auc = as.numeric(pROC::auc(1 - specificity, sensitivity)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# --------------------------------------------------
# 7. Mean AUC + 95% CI
# --------------------------------------------------

auc_summary <- auc_df |>
  group_by(.level) |>
  summarise(
    mean_auc = mean(auc),
    lower_ci = quantile(auc, 0.025),
    upper_ci = quantile(auc, 0.975),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# --------------------------------------------------
# 8. Plot ROC curves
# --------------------------------------------------

p_roc_mean <- ggplot(
  roc_mean,
  aes(
    x = 1 - specificity,
    y = mean_sensitivity,
    colour = .level
  )
) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.3) +
  geom_abline(
    slope = 1,
    intercept = 0,
    linetype = "dashed",
    colour = "grey60"
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~.level) +
  geom_text(
    data = auc_summary,
    aes(
      x = 0.6,
      y = 0.1,
      label = paste0(
        "AUC = ",
        round(mean_auc, 2),
        " (",
        round(lower_ci, 2),
        "–",
        round(upper_ci, 2),
        ")"
      )
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    size = 5
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = Subgroup_colors) +
  theme_hiv() +
  labs(
    x = "1 - Specificity",
    y = "Sensitivity",
    colour = "HIV subgroup",
    title = "Mean ROC curves across model splits"
  )

p_roc_mean

# --------------------------------------------------
# 9. Save
# --------------------------------------------------

ggsave(
  "../plots/pdf/model/Mean_ROC_per_HIV_subgroup_fu.pdf",
  p_roc_mean,
  width = 14,
  height = 7
)

ggsave(
  "../plots/png/model/Mean_ROC_per_HIV_subgroup_fu.png",
  p_roc_mean,
  width = 14,
  height = 7
)
```

### Alternative

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

# --------------------------------------------------
# 1. Extract ROC curves
# --------------------------------------------------

roc_all <- purrr::imap_dfr(
  model_results,
  function(model, split_name) {
    model$roc_curve$data |>
      mutate(Split = split_name)
  }
)

# --------------------------------------------------
# 2. Clean ROC curves
# --------------------------------------------------

roc_clean <- roc_all |>
  select(.level, Split, specificity, sensitivity) |>
  filter(!is.na(specificity), !is.na(sensitivity)) |>
  group_by(.level, Split, specificity) |>
  summarise(
    sensitivity = mean(sensitivity),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(.level, Split, specificity)

# --------------------------------------------------
# 3. Interpolate ROC curves (smooth lines)
# --------------------------------------------------

spec_grid <- seq(0, 1, length.out = 200)

roc_interp <- roc_clean |>
  group_by(.level, Split) |>
  group_modify(~{
    
    df <- arrange(.x, specificity)
    
    approx_res <- approx(
      x = df$specificity,
      y = df$sensitivity,
      xout = spec_grid,
      rule = 2
    )
    
    tibble(
      specificity = approx_res$x,
      sensitivity = approx_res$y
    )
    
  }) |>
  ungroup()

# --------------------------------------------------
# 4. Extract AUC (REMOVE macro/micro)
# --------------------------------------------------

auc_df <- purrr::imap_dfr(
  model_results,
  function(model, split_name) {
    
    model$metrics$auc |>
      rename(.level = Subgroup, auc = AUC) |>
      filter(!.level %in% c("macro", "micro")) |>   # 🔑 FIX
      mutate(Split = split_name)
    
  }
)

# --------------------------------------------------
# 5. Median AUC + IQR
# --------------------------------------------------

auc_summary <- auc_df |>
  group_by(.level) |>
  summarise(
    median_auc = median(auc),
    q1_auc     = quantile(auc, 0.25),
    q3_auc     = quantile(auc, 0.75),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# --------------------------------------------------
# 6. Select median split per subgroup
# --------------------------------------------------

median_split <- auc_df |>
  left_join(auc_summary, by = ".level") |>
  mutate(diff = abs(auc - median_auc)) |>
  group_by(.level) |>
  slice_min(diff, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) |>
  ungroup() |>
  select(.level, Split)

# --------------------------------------------------
# 7. Get ROC curves for median splits ONLY
# --------------------------------------------------

roc_median <- roc_interp |>
  inner_join(median_split, by = c(".level", "Split"))

# --------------------------------------------------
# 8. Plot
# --------------------------------------------------

p_roc_median <- ggplot(
  roc_median,
  aes(
    x = 1 - specificity,
    y = sensitivity,
    colour = .level
  )
) +

  # 🔘 All splits (background)
  geom_line(
    data = roc_interp,
    aes(
      x = 1 - specificity,
      y = sensitivity,
      group = interaction(Split, .level)
    ),
    color = "grey80",
    linewidth = 0.2,
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +

  # 🔵 Median ROC (foreground)
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.3) +

  geom_abline(
    slope = 1,
    intercept = 0,
    linetype = "dashed",
    colour = "grey60"
  ) +

  facet_wrap(~.level) +

  geom_text(
    data = auc_summary,
    aes(
      x = 0.6,
      y = 0.1,
      label = paste0(
        "AUC = ",
        round(median_auc, 2),
        " (",
        round(q1_auc, 2),
        "–",
        round(q3_auc, 2),
        ")"
      )
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    size = 5
  ) +

  scale_color_manual(values = Subgroup_colors) +
  theme_hiv() +
  labs(
    x = "1 - Specificity",
    y = "Sensitivity",
    colour = "HIV subgroup",
    title = "Median ROC curves per HIV subgroup",
    subtitle = "Grey = all splits, Color = median split, numbers = median (IQR)"
  )

p_roc_median

# --------------------------------------------------
# 9. Save
# --------------------------------------------------

ggsave(
  "../plots/pdf/model/Median_ROC_per_HIV_subgroup_fu.pdf",
  p_roc_median,
  width = 14,
  height = 7
)

ggsave(
  "../plots/png/model/Median_ROC_per_HIV_subgroup_fu.png",
  p_roc_median,
  width = 14,
  height = 7
)
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)

# --------------------------------------------------
# Extract metrics per split
# --------------------------------------------------

metrics_df <- purrr::imap_dfr(
  model_results,
  function(model, split_name) {

    # ---------------------------
    # AUC (per subgroup)
    # ---------------------------
    auc_df <- model$metrics$auc |>
      rename(Subgroup = Subgroup, AUC = AUC)

    # ---------------------------
    # Other metrics (single values)
    # ---------------------------
    accuracy    <- model$metrics$accuracy
    sensitivity <- model$metrics$sensitivity
    specificity <- model$metrics$specificity

    # ---------------------------
    # Combine
    # ---------------------------
    auc_df |>
      mutate(
        Split       = split_name,
        Accuracy    = accuracy,
        Sensitivity = sensitivity,
        Specificity = specificity
      )

  }
)

# --------------------------------------------------
# Optional: remove macro/micro
# --------------------------------------------------

metrics_df_clean <- metrics_df |>
  filter(!Subgroup %in% c("macro", "micro"))

metrics_df_clean
metrics_df_clean |> write_xlsx("../tables/Multivariate_LASSO/Supplementary Table 11 fu.xlsx")

  )

summary_df
```

## S10A

```{r}
# ---------------------------
# 1. Extract HIV-RNA baseline per ID
# ---------------------------
rna_df <- metadata |>
  filter(Disease == "HIV") |>
  mutate(ID = as.character(ID)) |>
  select(ID, `HIV-RNA (baseline)`) |>
  filter(!is.na(`HIV-RNA (baseline)`)) |>
  distinct() |>
  rename(hiv_rna_baseline = `HIV-RNA (baseline)`)

# ---------------------------
# 2. Extract BASELINE protein samples
# ---------------------------
baseline_proteins <- metadata |>
  filter(
    Disease == "HIV",
    Timepoint == "Baseline"
  ) |>
  select(DAid, ID) |>
  mutate(ID = as.character(ID)) |>
  inner_join(data_wide, by = "DAid") |>
  inner_join(rna_df, by = "ID")

# ---------------------------

# ---------------------------
cor_results <- baseline_proteins |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -c(DAid, ID, hiv_rna_baseline),
    names_to = "Feature",
    values_to = "Protein"
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(Protein), !is.na(hiv_rna_baseline)) |>
  group_by(Feature) |>
  summarise(
    test = list(cor.test(hiv_rna_baseline, Protein, method = "spearman")),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    Correlation = map_dbl(test, ~ .x$estimate),
    pval        = map_dbl(test, ~ .x$p.value),
    neglog10p   = -log10(pval),
    sig_class   = if_else(pval < 0.05, "p < 0.05", "Not significant")
  )

# ---------------------------
# 4. Select top ± correlations for labeling
# ---------------------------
label_df_up <- cor_results |>
  arrange(desc(Correlation)) |>
  slice_head(n = 10)

label_df_down <- cor_results |>
  arrange(Correlation) |>
  slice_head(n = 10)

label_df <- bind_rows(label_df_up, label_df_down)

# ---------------------------
# 5. Volcano plot
# ---------------------------
p_corr_hiv_baseline_proteome_baseline <- ggplot(
  cor_results,
  aes(x = Correlation, y = neglog10p, color = sig_class)
) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6, size = 2) +
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = -log10(0.05),
    linetype = "dashed",
    colour = "grey50"
  ) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = 0,
    linetype = "dashed",
    colour = "grey50"
  ) +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
    data = label_df,
    aes(label = Feature),
    size = 4,
    max.overlaps = Inf,
    box.padding = 0.6,
    point.padding = 0.4,
    segment.color = "grey60"
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "p < 0.05"        = "#D55E00",
      "Not significant" = "grey75"
    )
  ) +
  theme_hiv() +
  labs(
    x = "Spearman correlation (r)",
    y =  expression(-log[10]("p-value")),
    color = NULL,
    title = "Plasma proteins (at baseline) correlated with HIV-RNA (at baseline)"
  )

p_corr_hiv_baseline_proteome_baseline
```

## S10C

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(purrr)

# ---------------------------
# Colors
# ---------------------------
Subgroup_colors <- c(
  "Primary HIV infection"       = "#4B988F",
  "Severely impaired immunity"  = "#EABBBB",
  "More preserved immunity"     = "#C89A1B",
  "Elite controller"            = "#5A588B",
  "Healthy"                     = "#BDBDBD"
)

# ---------------------------
# Proteins
# ---------------------------
proteins_of_interest <- c("LAG3", "DDX58", "CXCL10", "CLEC4A", "GZMA", "GZMB")
hiv_subgroups <- c(
  "Primary HIV infection",
  "More preserved immunity",
  "Severely impaired immunity",
  "Elite controller"
)

# ---------------------------
# Data
# ---------------------------
scatter_data <- metadata |>
  filter(
    Disease == "HIV",
    Subgroup %in% hiv_subgroups,
    Timepoint == "Baseline"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    HIVRNA_log10 = log10(`HIV-RNA (baseline)` + 1),
    Subgroup = factor(Subgroup, levels = hiv_subgroups)
  ) |>
  select(DAid, HIVRNA_log10, Subgroup) |>
  filter(!is.na(HIVRNA_log10)) |>
  inner_join(data_wide, by = "DAid") |>
  pivot_longer(
    -c(DAid, HIVRNA_log10, Subgroup),
    names_to  = "Feature",
    values_to = "NPX"
  ) |>
  filter(
    Feature %in% proteins_of_interest,
    !is.na(NPX)
  )

# ---------------------------
# Subgroup correlations (with positions)
# ---------------------------
subgroup_cor <- scatter_data |>
  group_by(Feature, Subgroup) |>
  summarise(
    test = list(cor.test(HIVRNA_log10, NPX,
                         method = "spearman",
                         exact = FALSE)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    R    = map_dbl(test, ~ .x$estimate),
    pval = map_dbl(test, ~ .x$p.value),
    label = paste0(
      "R = ", sprintf("%.2f", R),
      ", p = ", signif(pval, 2)
    )
  ) |>
  arrange(Feature, Subgroup) |>
  ungroup()

# Position labels in each facet's native data coordinates. This avoids
# overlap when facet panels have different y-axis ranges.
facet_label_pos <- scatter_data |>
  group_by(Feature) |>
  summarise(
    x_min = min(HIVRNA_log10, na.rm = TRUE),
    x_max = max(HIVRNA_log10, na.rm = TRUE),
    y_min = min(NPX, na.rm = TRUE),
    y_max = max(NPX, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    x_range = pmax(x_max - x_min, 1),
    y_range = pmax(y_max - y_min, 1),
    x_pos   = x_min + 0.03 * x_range,
    y_top   = y_max - 0.04 * y_range,
    y_step  = 0.12 * y_range
  )

subgroup_cor <- subgroup_cor |>
  left_join(facet_label_pos, by = "Feature") |>
  group_by(Feature) |>
  mutate(
    y_pos = y_top - (row_number() - 1) * y_step
  ) |>
  ungroup()

# ---------------------------
# Global correlations (facet titles)
# ---------------------------
global_cor <- scatter_data |>
  group_by(Feature) |>
  summarise(
    test = list(cor.test(HIVRNA_log10, NPX,
                         method = "spearman",
                         exact = FALSE)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    R    = map_dbl(test, ~ .x$estimate),
    pval = map_dbl(test, ~ .x$p.value),
    facet_label = paste0(
      Feature,
      "\nR = ", sprintf("%.2f", R),
      ", p-val = ", signif(pval, 2)
    )
  )

facet_labels <- setNames(global_cor$facet_label, global_cor$Feature)

# ---------------------------
# Plot
# ---------------------------
p_hivrna_corr <- ggplot(
  scatter_data,
  aes(x = HIVRNA_log10, y = NPX, color = Subgroup)
) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7, size = 2) +

  geom_smooth(
    method = "lm",
    se = TRUE,
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +

  # Subgroup labels, positioned separately within each facet.
  geom_text(
    data = subgroup_cor,
    aes(
      x = x_pos,
      y = y_pos,
      label = label,
      color = Subgroup
    ),
    hjust = 0,
    vjust = 1,
    size = 3.2,
    lineheight = 1.15,
    show.legend = FALSE,
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +

  facet_wrap(
    ~ Feature,
    scales = "free_y",
    labeller = as_labeller(facet_labels)
  ) +

  scale_color_manual(values = Subgroup_colors) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.05))) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.20))) +
  theme_hiv() +
  labs(
    x = expression(log[10] * " HIV RNA at baseline (copies/mL)"),
    y = "Protein level (NPX)",
    color = "HIV subgroup",
    title = "Baseline HIV RNA vs protein levels",
    subtitle = "Colored = subgroup correlations, facet titles = overall correlation"
  )

p_hivrna_corr
```

```{r}
# ---------------------------
# 2. Extract FOLLOW-UP protein samples

  filter(
    Disease == "HIV",
```

## S10F

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(purrr)

# ---------------------------
# Colors
# ---------------------------
Subgroup_colors <- c(
  "Primary HIV infection"       = "#4B988F",
  "Severely impaired immunity"  = "#EABBBB",
  "More preserved immunity"     = "#C89A1B",
  "Elite controller"            = "#5A588B",
  "Healthy"                     = "#BDBDBD"
)

# ---------------------------
# Proteins
# ---------------------------
proteins_of_interest <- c("CD5", "DDX58", "IL17C", "ITGAV", "SKAP1", "LAG3")
hiv_subgroups <- c(
  "Primary HIV infection",
  "More preserved immunity",
  "Severely impaired immunity",
  "Elite controller"
)

# ---------------------------
# Data (UPDATED)
# ---------------------------
scatter_data <- metadata |>
  filter(
    Disease == "HIV",
    Subgroup %in% hiv_subgroups,
    Timepoint == "Baseline"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    CD4_baseline = `CD4 cell count (baseline)`,
    Subgroup = factor(Subgroup, levels = hiv_subgroups)
  ) |>
  select(DAid, CD4_baseline, Subgroup) |>
  filter(!is.na(CD4_baseline)) |>
  inner_join(data_wide, by = "DAid") |>
  pivot_longer(
    -c(DAid, CD4_baseline, Subgroup),
    names_to  = "Feature",
    values_to = "NPX"
  ) |>
  filter(
    Feature %in% proteins_of_interest,
    !is.na(NPX)
  )

# ---------------------------
# Subgroup correlations (UPDATED)
# ---------------------------
subgroup_cor <- scatter_data |>
  group_by(Feature, Subgroup) |>
  summarise(
    test = list(cor.test(CD4_baseline, NPX,
                         method = "spearman",
                         exact = FALSE)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    R    = map_dbl(test, ~ .x$estimate),
    pval = map_dbl(test, ~ .x$p.value),
    label = paste0(
      "R = ", sprintf("%.2f", R),
      ", p = ", signif(pval, 2)
    )
  ) |>
  arrange(Feature, Subgroup) |>
  ungroup()

# Position labels in each facet's native data coordinates.
facet_label_pos <- scatter_data |>
  group_by(Feature) |>
  summarise(
    x_min = min(CD4_baseline, na.rm = TRUE),
    x_max = max(CD4_baseline, na.rm = TRUE),
    y_min = min(NPX, na.rm = TRUE),
    y_max = max(NPX, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    x_range = pmax(x_max - x_min, 1),
    y_range = pmax(y_max - y_min, 1),
    x_pos   = x_min + 0.03 * x_range,
    y_top   = y_max - 0.04 * y_range,
    y_step  = 0.12 * y_range
  )

subgroup_cor <- subgroup_cor |>
  left_join(facet_label_pos, by = "Feature") |>
  group_by(Feature) |>
  mutate(
    y_pos = y_top - (row_number() - 1) * y_step
  ) |>
  ungroup()

# ---------------------------
# Global correlations (UPDATED)
# ---------------------------
global_cor <- scatter_data |>
  group_by(Feature) |>
  summarise(
    test = list(cor.test(CD4_baseline, NPX,
                         method = "spearman",
                         exact = FALSE)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    R    = map_dbl(test, ~ .x$estimate),
    pval = map_dbl(test, ~ .x$p.value),
    facet_label = paste0(
      Feature,
      "\nR = ", sprintf("%.2f", R),
      ", p = ", signif(pval, 2)
    )
  )

facet_labels <- setNames(global_cor$facet_label, global_cor$Feature)

# ---------------------------
# Plot (UPDATED)
# ---------------------------
p_cd4_corr <- ggplot(
  scatter_data,
  aes(x = CD4_baseline, y = NPX, color = Subgroup)
) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7, size = 2) +

  geom_smooth(
    method = "lm",
    se = TRUE,
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +

  geom_text(
    data = subgroup_cor,
    aes(
      x = x_pos,
      y = y_pos,
      label = label,
      color = Subgroup
    ),
    hjust = 0,
    vjust = 1,
    size = 3.2,
    lineheight = 1.15,
    show.legend = FALSE,
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +

  facet_wrap(
    ~ Feature,
    scales = "free_y",
    labeller = as_labeller(facet_labels)
  ) +

  scale_color_manual(values = Subgroup_colors) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.05))) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.20))) +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  theme_hiv() +
  labs(
    x = "CD4 cell count at baseline (cells/µL)",   # 🔑 updated label
    y = "Protein level (NPX)",
    color = "HIV subgroup",
    title = "Baseline CD4 cell count vs protein levels",
    subtitle = "Colored = subgroup correlations, facet titles = overall correlation"
  )

p_cd4_corr
```

# Supplementary Figure 11

## S11A-S11E

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(pheatmap)

plot_protein_clinical_correlation_per_subgroup <- function(
  protein_vector,
  subcategories,
  out_dir = "../plots/pdf/correlation/"
) {

  dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

  # ---------------------------
  # Helper: correlation matrix
  # ---------------------------
  get_corr_matrix <- function(timepoint_label, proteins, subcat) {

    meta_sub <- metadata %>%
      filter(
        Disease == "HIV",
        Timepoint == timepoint_label,
        Subgroup == subcat
      ) %>%
      select(DAid, where(is.numeric)) %>%
      distinct()

    npx_sub <- data_long %>%
      filter(Feature %in% proteins) %>%
      select(DAid, Feature, NPX) %>%
      pivot_wider(
        names_from  = Feature,
        values_from = NPX
      )

    combined <- inner_join(npx_sub, meta_sub, by = "DAid") %>%
      select(-DAid) %>%
      select(where(~ sum(!is.na(.)) > 2 & sd(., na.rm = TRUE) > 0))

    if (ncol(combined) < 3) return(NULL)

    cor(
      combined,
      use    = "pairwise.complete.obs",
      method = "spearman"
    )
  }

  # ---------------------------
  # Loop over subcategories
  # ---------------------------
  for (subcat in subcategories) {

    message("Processing: ", subcat)

    cor_baseline <- get_corr_matrix("Baseline", protein_vector, subcat)
    cor_followup <- get_corr_matrix("Follow-up", protein_vector, subcat)

    if (is.null(cor_baseline) || is.null(cor_followup)) {
      message("  Skipping (insufficient data)")
      next
    }

    shared_vars <- intersect(
      rownames(cor_baseline),
      rownames(cor_followup)
    )

    if (length(shared_vars) < 3) {
      message("  Skipping (too few shared variables)")
      next
    }

    cor_baseline <- cor_baseline[shared_vars, shared_vars]
    cor_followup <- cor_followup[shared_vars, shared_vars]

    combined_cor <- cor_baseline
    combined_cor[upper.tri(combined_cor)] <-
      cor_followup[upper.tri(combined_cor)]

    combined_numbers <- matrix(
      "",
      nrow = nrow(combined_cor),
      ncol = ncol(combined_cor),
      dimnames = dimnames(combined_cor)
    )

    combined_numbers[lower.tri(combined_numbers)] <- formatC(
      cor_baseline[lower.tri(cor_baseline)],
      digits = 2, format = "f"
    )

    combined_numbers[upper.tri(combined_numbers)] <- formatC(
      cor_followup[upper.tri(cor_followup)],
      digits = 2, format = "f"
    )

    var_group <- data.frame(
      Group = ifelse(
        rownames(combined_cor) %in% protein_vector,
        "Protein",
        "Clinical"
      ),
      row.names = rownames(combined_cor)
    )

    corr_colors <- colorRampPalette(
      c("#6D9EC1", "white", "#E46726")
    )(100)

    corr_breaks <- seq(-1, 1, length.out = 101)

    var_order <- c(
      intersect(protein_vector, rownames(combined_cor)),
      setdiff(rownames(combined_cor), protein_vector)
    )

    # ---------------------------
    # Save ONE PDF per subgroup
    # ---------------------------
    pdf(
      file = file.path(
        out_dir,
        paste0(
          "Protein_Clinical_Correlation_",
          gsub(" ", "_", subcat),
          ".pdf"
        )
      ),
      width  = 14,
      height = 12
    )

    pheatmap(
      combined_cor[var_order, var_order],
      color             = corr_colors,
      breaks            = corr_breaks,
      annotation_col    = var_group,
      annotation_row    = var_group,
      annotation_colors = list(
        Group = c(
          "Protein"  = "#A6CEE3",
          "Clinical" = "#B2DF8A"
        )
      ),
      cluster_rows      = FALSE,
      cluster_cols      = FALSE,
      gaps_row          = length(intersect(protein_vector, var_order)),
      gaps_col          = length(intersect(protein_vector, var_order)),
      display_numbers   = combined_numbers[var_order, var_order],
      number_color      = "black",
      number_fontsize   = 6,
      main = paste0(
        "Spearman Correlation – ", subcat,
        "\nBaseline (lower) vs Follow-up (upper)"
      ),
      fontsize_row = 8,
      fontsize_col = 8
    )

    dev.off()
  }
}

my_proteins <- c(
  "CXCL13",
  "NOS3",
  "DPEP2",
  "FABP5",
  "CD4",
  "CD6",
  "DDX58",
  "KIR3DL1",
  "SLAMF7",
  "SIGLEC1"
)

subcategories_to_plot <- c(
  "Primary HIV infection",
  "More preserved immunity",
  "Severely impaired immunity",
  "Elite controller"
)

plot_protein_clinical_correlation_per_subgroup(
  protein_vector = my_proteins,
  subcategories  = subcategories_to_plot
)
```
